source: HDB via data.gov.sg · URA Data Service
note: Median psf by calendar year, in 10 sqm size bands, from the full filed history. Rows are [year, medianPsf, n]. A year with fewer than 3 sales is kept with its count rather than dropped, so a reader can see what is standing behind it. The "all" band is every size at that address, which is what a headline year-on-year figure measures and is why the two can disagree.
